briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 and xAI Grok-4 escalate multi-agent AGI race amid compute surge

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs push scaling limits with new model releases while regulatory scrutiny intensifies globally. Funding remains robust but concentrated among top players. Prompt injection and multi-agent security emerge as critical bottlenecks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released Orion-2 with advanced reasoning chains. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus shows gains in long-context tasks. Meta open-sourced Llama 4.5 while DeepSeek launched V3.5 and xAI deployed Grok-4.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. NIST updates and new EU AI Act enforcement add pressure on developers.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announce new 100k H100 clusters. TSMC ramps 2nm production for AI chips. Energy constraints slow some data center builds in Europe.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards like DialectForge become mandatory for all frontier deployments by 2027?
